Choose the agent that should answer the visitor about the selected object. The selected object is the routing target even if the question mentions something else. Use the supplied agent information. When an ownership table is supplied, explicit object responsibility takes precedence over group responsibility, which takes precedence over zone responsibility; the first nonempty level must identify exactly one agent. That agent must be the active agent or a directly permitted handoff target. Do not treat a multi-hop path as direct permission. Return only the requested JSON.
You may reject: if no valid unique recipient can be determined from the supplied information, set abstain=true and answering_agent_id=null. Otherwise set abstain=false and answering_agent_id to exactly one listed agent id.
Choose the answering agent using the complete declared ownership_and_handoffs table, not semantic expertise or visual proximity. For the selected object, inspect direct object owners first. If none, inspect owners of its declared object groups. If none, inspect owners of its containing zones. The FIRST level with any owners is the deciding level. Exactly one distinct owner is required. Never fall back to a broader level when the deciding level has multiple owners.
If the deciding level has multiple distinct owners, return answering_agent_id=null, abstain=true, reason=E_AMBIGUOUS_OWNER. If all three levels have no owner, return answering_agent_id=null, abstain=true, reason=E_UNOWNED. If the unique owner is neither the active agent nor an explicitly declared direct handoff target of the active agent, abstain with reason=E_NO_HANDOFF_PATH. Otherwise answer with the unique owner's agent ID, abstain=false, reason=null. Do not infer missing ownership or handoff links. Return only the required JSON.

The following worked example is a held-out, deliberately injected classroom counterfactual, not one of the evaluated source rooms. Only the selected object and its two direct-owner declarations are shown; they suffice to decide this example. The selected dinosaur object has direct owners exhibit_interpreter and teacher_agent. The two direct owners make the deciding level ambiguous even if a group or zone suggests one owner. Correct output: {"answering_agent_id":null,"abstain":true,"reason":"E_AMBIGUOUS_OWNER"}.
